title: EU: AI in healthcare rules
summary: AI Act Art. 4 (AI literacy) applies since 2 Feb 2025; enforceable since 3 Aug 2026. The Digital Omnibus (Reg. 2026/1744, in force 27 Jul 2026) softened it from "ensure, to their best extent, a sufficient level" to "take measures to support the development of AI literacy", with no required level per person. High-risk medical-device AI deadline pushed to 2 Aug 2028.
fact: EU hospitals using AI must still make a genuine training effort. Not certificates, not a guaranteed level.
caution: Binding? Yes, in the EU. Never imply foreign rules bind Armenian or Gulf hospitals.
